license_required.quote: No person shall practice dentistry or dental hygiene or hold himself or herself out to the public in this State as being qualified to practice dentistry or dental hygiene or use in connection with the person's name, or otherwise assume or use, any title or description conveying or tending to convey the impression that the person is qualified to practice dentistry or dental hygiene unless such person has been duly licensed under this chapter.

issuing_authority.value: State Board of Dentistry and Dental Hygiene
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" shall mean the State Board of Dentistry and Dental Hygiene established in this chapter.

name.value: State Board of Dentistry and Dental Hygiene
name.quote: "Board" shall mean the State Board of Dentistry and Dental Hygiene established in this chapter.

type.quote: The State Board of Dentistry and Dental Hygiene shall have authority to
type.citation: § 1106. Powers and duties of the Board.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Division" shall mean the State Division of Professional Regulation.

degree_required.value: Degree in dentistry from an accredited dental college or university
degree_required.quote: Has received a degree in dentistry from an accredited dental college or university accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association.
degree_required.citation: § 1122. Qualifications of applicant for Delaware-specific dental license; report to Attorney General.

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association.
accrediting_body.citation: § 1122. Qualifications of applicant for Delaware-specific dental license; report to Attorney General.

required.quote: Has acquired 1 year's experience as a dental intern within a general practice residency accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association ("CODA").
required.citation: § 1122. Qualifications of applicant for Delaware-specific dental license; report to Attorney General.

duration.quote: Has acquired 1 year's experience as a dental intern within a general practice residency accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association ("CODA").
duration.citation: § 1122. Qualifications of applicant for Delaware-specific dental license; report to Attorney General.

kind.value: general practice residency or CODA-approved specialty residency
kind.quote: Has acquired 1 year's experience as a dental intern within a general practice residency accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association ("CODA"). b. Has completed a CODA-approved specialty residency with those specific rotations identified in the Board's rules and regulations.
kind.citation: § 1122. Qualifications of applicant for Delaware-specific dental license; report to Attorney General.

exams.name: National Board of Dental Examiners examination
exams.quote: Has achieved a passing score on the Delaware jurisprudence and National Board of Dental Examiners' examinations.
exams.citation: § 1122. Qualifications of applicant for Delaware-specific dental license; report to Attorney General.

exams.name: Delaware jurisprudence examination
exams.notes: Written jurisprudence examination on Delaware laws pertaining to dentistry
exams.quote: Has successfully passed a written jurisprudence examination on Delaware laws pertaining to dentistry.

exams.name: Delaware practical examination
exams.notes: Validated practical examination prepared and administered by the Board
exams.quote: An applicant applying for licensure by examination shall successfully pass, with a score established by the Board, a validated practical examination prepared and administered by the Board.

interval_years.quote: Each license shall be renewed biennially, in such manner as is determined by the Division
interval_years.citation: § 1126. Issuance and renewal of licenses; replacement of licenses.

required.quote: Establish by rule and regulation continuing education standards required for license renewal for dentists and dental hygienists
required.citation: § 1106. Powers and duties of the Board.

available.quote: the Board shall grant a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene to each applicant who presents proof of current licensure in "good standing" in another state, the District of Columbia, or territory of the United States
available.citation: § 1124. Dentists and dental hygienists licensed in other jurisdictions.

requirements.value: Must hold current license in good standing in another state; for dentists, must have 3 years of active dental practice in another jurisdiction and meet education and examination requirements; for hygienists, must have practiced 3 of the last 5 years; CPR certification required; must satisfy character and background requirements.
requirements.quote: Has submitted proof that the applicant has had 3 years of active dental practice in another state, the District of Columbia, or a territory of the United States.
requirements.citation: § 1124. Dentists and dental hygienists licensed in other jurisdictions.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice dentistry or dental hygiene or hold himself or herself out to the public in this State as being qualified to practice dentistry or dental hygiene ... unless such person has been duly licensed under this chapter.

credential_type.quote: The Board shall issue a license to each applicant who meets the requirements of this chapter for licensure as a dentist or dental hygienist
credential_type.citation: § 1126. Issuance and renewal of licenses; replacement of licenses.

is_mandatory.quote: Whoever practices or attempts to practice dentistry or dental hygiene within this State without having been licensed to practice dentistry or dental hygiene or during the period of suspension or revocation of such license previously granted shall be fined
is_mandatory.citation: § 1178. Practice without registration or certificate; separate offenses; penalty.

title_protection.quote: No person shall practice dentistry or dental hygiene or hold himself or herself out to the public in this State as being qualified to practice dentistry or dental hygiene or use in connection with the person's name, or otherwise assume or use, any title or description conveying or tending to convey the impression that the person is qualified to practice dentistry or dental hygiene unless such person has been duly licensed under this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: A person not currently licensed as a dentist or dental hygienist under this chapter who engages in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene ... shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception to acquire a license, impersonated a licensee, allowed another to use the practitioner's license, or aided an unlicensed person to represent themselves as a dentist or dental hygienist.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception in order to acquire a license as a dentist or dental hygienist, has impersonated another person holding a license or has allowed another person to use the practitioner's license, or has aided or abetted a person not licensed as a dentist or dental hygienist to represent himself or herself as a dentist or dental hygienist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced dentistry or dental hygiene in an incompetent or grossly negligent manner or was otherwise guilty of misconduct or unprofessional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced dentistry or dental hygiene in an incompetent or grossly negligent manner or has otherwise been guilty of misconduct or unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of any offense the circumstances of which substantially relate to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of any offense the circumstances of which substantially relate to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in an act of consumer fraud or deception, illegal restraint of competition, or illegal price-fixing activities.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in an act of consumer fraud or deception, engaged in the illegal restraint of competition, or participated in illegal price-fixing activities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a provision of this chapter or any regulation established thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated a provision of this chapter or any regulation established thereunder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had license suspended or revoked, or had other disciplinary action taken by the appropriate licensing authority in another jurisdiction for conduct that would be prohibited under this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had the practitioner's license as a dentist or dental hygienist suspended or revoked, or has had other disciplinary action taken against the dentist or dental hygienist by the appropriate licensing authority in another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to notify the Board that the practitioner's license in another state has been subject to discipline, surrendered, suspended, or revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to notify the Board that the practitioner's license as a dentist or dental hygienist in another state has been subject to discipline or has been surrendered, suspended or revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has a physical condition such that the performance of dentistry or dental hygiene is or may be injurious or prejudicial to the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has a physical condition such that the performance of dentistry or dental hygiene is or may be injurious or prejudicial to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had United States Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) privileges restricted or revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had the practitioner's United States Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) privileges restricted or revoked

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in the excessive use or abuse of drugs.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the excessive use or abuse of drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Maintained a facility in an unsanitary or unsafe condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has maintained a facility in an unsanitary or unsafe condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony sexual offense.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony sexual offense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report child abuse or neglect as required by § 903 of Title 16.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report child abuse or neglect as required by § 903 of Title 16, or any successor thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report to the Division of Professional Regulation as required by § 1131A.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report to the Division of Professional Regulation as required by § 1131A of this title.

definition_quote.value: the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and treatment (nonsurgical, surgical or related procedures) of diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body provided by a dentist within the scope of the dentist's education, training and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of dentistry" is defined as the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and treatment (nonsurgical, surgical or related procedures) of diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body provided by a dentist within the scope of the dentist's education, training and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law.

methods_authorized.quote: evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and treatment (nonsurgical, surgical or related procedures) of diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and the adjacent and associated structures

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe any drug necessary in the practice of dentistry, dental surgery or oral surgery; prescriptions must be electronic except in specified circumstances.
drug_authority.quote: Pharmacists licensed by this State may fill prescriptions of dentists licensed by this State for any drug necessary in the practice of dentistry, dental surgery or oral surgery.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: Define 3 levels of supervision by rule and regulation.
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.citation: § 1106. Powers and duties of the Board.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A licensed dental hygienist may also practice under the general supervision of the State Dental Director, or the State Dental Director's designee, who shall be a Delaware licensed dentist, in federally qualified health centers, nonprofit organizations, and other locations as designated by the Delaware Health Care Commission

value: other locations designated by the Delaware Health Care Commission
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A licensed dental hygienist may also practice under the general supervision of the State Dental Director, or the State Dental Director's designee, who shall be a Delaware licensed dentist, in federally qualified health centers, nonprofit organizations, and other locations as designated by the Delaware Health Care Commission

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Any dentist who practices or offers to practice dentistry or dental surgery may use a trade name that is not false, misleading or deceptive provided that the proper name of 1 of the owners, all of whom must be dentists, is used in conjunction with the trade name.
dental_office_ownership_restrictions.citation: § 1171. Name used in practice of dentistry.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: No person shall repair, construct, adjust or alter any appliance, denture or dental restoration except under the authorization and responsibility of a licensed practitioner of dentistry as defined by this chapter.
dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.citation: § 1135. Certain unlawful acts; supervision by dentists.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: The State Board of Dentistry and Dental Hygiene created pursuant to Chapter 11 of this title.
teledentistry_authorized.citation: § 6002. Authorization to practice by telehealth and telemedicine.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: Establish by rule and regulation the requirement to and standards for permits that authorize dental hygienists to administer local anesthesia under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist.
hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.citation: § 1106. Powers and duties of the Board [Effective upon fullfilment of the contingency in 85 Del. Laws, c. 167, § 5].

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Shall submit proof of current certification in cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) technique in accordance with regulations adopted by the Board.
cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.citation: § 1122. Qualifications of applicant for Delaware-specific dental license; report to Attorney General.
